source_file: API Drill Pipe Identification chart (Drilling Professionals Page reference)
description: API tool-joint identification: grooves and slots cut into the tong-area band of a drill-pipe tool joint identify the grade + weight class. The shape is parametric (grooves are circumferential bands, slots are short axial cuts). This table is what the visual recognizer should match against.

rows.notes: Baseline drill pipe — no identifying marks on the tool joint.
Single circumferential groove on the tong area.
Two grooves on the tong area.
Three grooves on the tong area.
Heavy-weight drill pipe (HWDP), grade E75 — single axial slot.
Heavy-weight, G105 — single wide groove (wider than the standard-weight single-groove mark).
Heavy-weight high-strength drill pipe — combination of one groove + one slot.
Standard-weight high-strength drill pipe — slot above a groove (mirror of heavy + groove + slot).
